# WEBXWHALE

> WEBXWHALE is a technology brand building digital products, learning tools, and web experiences.

Canonical website: https://webxwhale.com/

## Main pages

- [Home](https://webxwhale.com/home): Overview of WEBXWHALE, its learning platforms, digital products, and services.
- [Services](https://webxwhale.com/services): Overview of available technology and digital services.
- [Web Development](https://webxwhale.com/services/web-development): Website and web application development services, including responsive business websites, e-commerce experiences, and custom web projects.
- [Products](https://webxwhale.com/products): Digital products and learning platforms from WEBXWHALE, including SQLwhale, Resume Analyzer, AI 8D Audio Converter, and Webchat.
- [About WEBXWHALE](https://webxwhale.com/aboutus): Brand overview and areas of focus.
- [Contact](https://webxwhale.com/contact): Contact and enquiry form.
- [Privacy Policy](https://webxwhale.com/privacy): Privacy information.
- [Terms](https://webxwhale.com/terms): Website terms.

## Featured products

- [SQLwhale](https://sqlwhalefrontend.vercel.app/): Hands-on SQL learning and practice.
- [Resume Analyzer bot](https://t.me/ScanMyResumeBot): Resume analysis tool.
- [AI 8D Audio Converter](https://project911-flame.vercel.app/): Audio conversion product.
- [Webchat](https://webwhalechat.netlify.app/): Web-based chat product.
